posts.text: Spark Hackathon x Case Competition is officially wrapped! ✨ After months of planning since the summer, Ryhana Williams and I finally executed and ran Western Developers Society’s first Hackathon x Case Competition, focused on social good. It was our first time trying a combined hackathon and case comp format, and building the very first iteration of Spark turned out to be far more rewarding and fun than I expected.
